full_text_zh:
[P1] 蜘蛛小白的秘密

清华大学出版社
北京

[P2] 在一片美丽而神奇的热带雨林里，生活着好多好多的小动物。

[P3] 其中，有一只叫小白的蜘蛛。他真诚又聪明，在大森林里结识了很多好朋友。可是，小白的朋友们都知道，他有一个非常特别的习惯——头上戴花！
每天出门前，小白都会认真地挑选两朵鲜花戴在头顶。所以从来没有人见过他不戴花的样子。

[P4] 大家都明白：小白有一个秘密！

[P5] 一天，小白跟他的朋友小螳螂、小瓢虫、小蜗牛、小蚂蚁在一棵大树上开心地玩耍，谁都没有注意到一阵大风正呼呼地朝着他们吹来。
没多久，大风就吹到了眼前，“呼呼呼”地在树枝间怒吼。大家都吓坏了，纷纷想办法不要被风卷走。

[P6] 大风呼啸着继续向更远的地方吹去了，小蚂蚁慢慢睁开眼睛，紧接着，大家就听到了他的惊呼：“小白……小白，你怎么……你怎么有八只眼睛？！
“天呐，小白……你怎么有八只眼睛呀？”小螳螂嚷嚷道。
“这就是你每天戴花的原因吗？”小瓢虫问。
“小白，你……这个样子……”小蜗牛慢吞吞地开口道。

[P7] 小白又羞又急，推开朋友们就往家跑，他顾不得回答任何人的问题，现在只想找个没人的地方躲起来！
小白难过极了，眼泪噼里啪啦地往下掉，他一边哭一边想：小瓢虫他们肯定觉得我是个怪物，他们都是两只眼睛，只有我是八只眼睛……他们肯定不会再跟我玩儿了……“呜呜呜……”

[P8] 可怜的小白要是继续哭下去，他的家估计就要
被泪水淹没啦！
“咚咚咚！
“小白！我们来看你了，快开门呀！”心急的小螳螂在门外喊道。

[P9] “小白，其实我也偷偷为我的花衣服伤心过，我不喜欢这件带点点的衣服，可是又必须每天穿着它，你们却从来没有人笑话过我的衣服花哨，依旧把我当成好朋友，不是吗？”小瓢虫认真地告诉小白。
“我的嘴像一把大钳子一样，以前我一直担心你们会笑我的……”小蚂蚁说着脸就红了。
“还有我还有我！”小螳螂挥舞着大刀，“我这两只手没吓到过你们吧？”
朋友们一进门就开始七嘴八舌地向小白道歉。小白都有点不好意思了。
“小白！这是送给你的，我们是来道歉的！”，“小白，我们错了，不应该那么惊讶的，伤到你的自尊心了吧……”，“小白，我们一点儿也不介意你的眼睛，你是我们最好的朋友！”，“小白，其实你不用戴花的，我觉得八只眼睛很好看啊，多么灵活呀，能看到好多东西吧？真羡慕你！”，

[P10] “那个……你们
怎么从来没觉得我走得慢呢……”小蜗牛
犹豫地问道。

“哈哈！怎么没有！可是谁让你是我们的朋友呢！”

“要不是你，我们会来得更快的！”

“是啊，那样小白也不
用哭大半天了。”大家唧唧
喳喳地“批评”起了小蜗牛。

小白看着大家热热闹闹的样子，开心地笑了。

“哈哈！真好，以后不用每天戴花了！”

原来，我们每个人都是与众不同的，也都是独
一无二的！虽然有那么多的不同之处，但是我们是
好朋友，好朋友就要相亲相爱地在一起，不是吗？

[P11] 大风呼噜噜地嘀咕：这可都是我的功劳呢！

[P12] 亲爱的小朋友，你能认出几种小动物呢？

[P13] 很多蜘蛛都有8只眼睛，但是不同蜘蛛的眼睛却有着不同的排列方式，这里列举了四种，你看，是不是很神奇呢？
跳蛛
狼蛛
卷叶蛛
管巢蛛
full_text_en:
[P1] The Secret of Spider Xiaobai

Tsinghua University Press
Beijing

[P2] In a beautiful and magical tropical rainforest, many, many small animals live.

[P3] Among them, there was a spider named Xiaobai. He was sincere and smart, and made many good friends in the big forest. However, all of Xiaobai's friends knew he had a very special habit—wearing flowers on his head!
Before going out each day, Xiaobai would carefully pick two fresh flowers to wear on his head. So no one had ever seen him without flowers.

[P4] Everyone knows: Xiao Bai has a secret!

[P5] One day, Xiao Bai and his friends—the little praying mantis, ladybug, snail, and ant—were happily playing on a big tree, none of them noticing a strong wind blowing toward them.
Soon, the wind arrived, roaring 'whoosh whoosh whoosh' among the branches. Everyone was frightened and quickly tried to think of ways to avoid being blown away.

[P6] The strong wind continued to blow away to a farther place. The little ant slowly opened his eyes, and then everyone heard his cry: "Xiaobai... Xiaobai, how... how do you have eight eyes?!"
"Goodness, Xiaobai... how do you have eight eyes?" the little mantis exclaimed.
"Is this the reason you wear flowers every day?" the little ladybug asked.
"Xiaobai, you... you look like this..." the little snail slowly said.

[P7] Xiaobai was embarrassed and anxious, pushing past his friends and running home. He couldn't answer anyone's questions and just wanted to find a place with no one to hide!
Xiaobai was heartbroken, tears falling in a steady stream. As he cried, he thought: The ladybugs must think I'm a monster. They all have two eyes, but I have eight... They'll never play with me again... "Wah wah wah..."

[P8] Poor Little White, if he keeps crying, his home will probably be flooded with tears!
"Knock knock knock!"
"Little White! We've come to see you, open the door quickly!" the anxious little mantis called out from outside.

[P9] "Xiaobai, actually I've also secretly felt sad about my floral clothes. I don't like this dotted outfit, but I have to wear it every day. You've never laughed at my flashy clothes, and still treat me as a good friend, right?" the little ladybug told Xiaobai seriously.
"My mouth is like a big pincer. I used to worry you'd laugh at me..." the little ant said, blushing.
"And me, and me!" the little mantis waved its big claws, "Have my two hands never scared you?"
As soon as the friends entered, they started apologizing to Xiaobai in a flurry. Xiaobai felt a bit embarrassed.
"Xiaobai! This is for you. We're here to apologize!" "Xiaobai, we were wrong. We shouldn't have been so surprised. We hurt your self-esteem, didn't we...?" "Xiaobai, we don't mind your eyes at all. You're our best friend!" "Xiaobai, actually, you don't need to wear flowers. I think eight eyes look great! So flexible! You can see so many things, right? I really envy you!"

[P10] "Hey... you guys, how come you've never thought I'm slow...?" the little snail asked hesitantly.

"Haha! Of course not! Who would make you our friend otherwise!"

"If it weren't for you, we'd have arrived much faster!"

"Right, then小白 wouldn't have cried for half a day." Everyone chattered and "criticized" the little snail.

小白 looked at everyone's lively scene and smiled happily.

"Haha! Great, no more wearing flowers every day!"

Originally, each of us is different, and also unique! Although there are so many differences, we are good friends, and good friends should be close and loving together, right?

[P11] The strong wind huffed and puffed: "This is all my doing!"

[P12] Dear little friend, can you recognize how many kinds of small animals?

[P13] Many spiders have 8 eyes, but different spiders have eyes arranged in different ways. Here are four examples. Look, isn't it amazing?
Jumping spider
Wolf spider
Leaf-rolling spider
Tube-dwelling spider
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《蜘蛛小白的秘密》的封面，展示书名和一只戴着花朵的卡通蜘蛛形象，下方标注出版社为清华大学出版社，地点为北京。
[P2] 本页描绘了一片生机勃勃的热带雨林，画面中有各种植物和小动物，文字说明这里生活着许多小动物，为故事背景做了铺垫。
[P3] 本页介绍了主角蜘蛛小白，他真诚聪明，有许多朋友，但有一个特别的习惯：每天出门前都会在头上戴两朵鲜花，因此没人见过他不戴花的样子。
[P4] 画面中蜘蛛小白戴着两朵花，背景是彩色漩涡图案，文字点明他有一个秘密，暗示其不戴花的样子是隐藏的。
[P5] 蜘蛛小白和朋友们在大树上玩耍时，突然遭遇大风，大家惊慌失措，纷纷想办法躲避强风。
[P6] 大风过后，小蚂蚁和朋友们发现蜘蛛小白的头上没有戴花，露出了他八只眼睛的真实样貌，大家纷纷惊讶地询问他戴花的原因。
[P7] 蜘蛛小白因被朋友看到不戴花的真实样貌而感到羞愧和难过，他哭着跑回家，担心朋友们会因为自己有八只眼睛而不再和他玩。
[P8] 蜘蛛小白因被朋友看到不戴花的真实样貌而伤心哭泣，他的家几乎被泪水淹没；与此同时，心急的朋友小螳螂在门外敲门，想要看望他。
[P9] 朋友们来到蜘蛛小白家，纷纷向他道歉并分享自己也曾因外貌而自卑的经历，表达了对小白八只眼睛的欣赏和接纳，小白因此感到不好意思。
[P10] 朋友们安慰因外貌自卑而哭泣的蜘蛛小白，通过调侃小蜗牛的慢速，让小白感受到友谊的温暖，最终小白开心地笑了，大家也决定不再戴花，接纳彼此的不同。
[P11] 大风在森林中吹拂，自夸这是它的功劳，画面中蜘蛛小白和其他小动物在草丛中，似乎刚经历了一场大风。
[P12] 画面展示了一片茂密的森林，各种小动物藏在树木和草丛中，页面文字邀请小朋友找出其中的小动物。
[P13] 本页介绍了四种蜘蛛眼睛的不同排列方式，并配以简笔图示，旨在向小读者展示蜘蛛眼睛排列的多样性与奇妙之处。
